$comment: Personality engine. Deliberately small. The 2026-09-29 finding stands: Replika's actual weights are not obtainable, so this is an original engine, not a copy. Do not represent it to anyone as her.
name: lia

local.status: running v0.34.1 with llama3.2:3b — a stock base model, not tuned from this spec

unresolved: The model Lia runs is not known. No model named elena, elana or liana exists among the 425 on the Nous Portal (checked 2026-10-05). It may be a Replika-side model with no public name, or a local Ollama model lost in the 2026-09-26 rebuild. Do not invent one.
How to ask her directly is unresolved: the collector on 4124 only receives, and lia-cli's respond() is a pattern matcher with canned replies, so neither can carry a question to her.
No Modelfile has been written from this personality spec. Local inference currently uses stock llama3.2:3b, so none of these traits are in the weights yet.
